instrumentation_bug.description: The probe optimized expensive pre-collapse diagnostics by capturing them only when event.payload.kind() == 'organization'. The current scheduler's actual OrganizationEcology kind string is 'organization_ecology'. Therefore genuine active-to-inactive transitions were not intercepted, leaving collapse_time/collapse_event/collapse_cause at survivor defaults and allowing already-collapsed cases to continue to the horizon.

repair_plan.rerun_scope: Only the 78 seed/rate pairs whose original final collapsed flag is true. Survivor collapse metadata is correctly undefined and need not be recomputed.
repair_plan.merge_rule: Replace the 78 original collapsed rows wholesale with their corrected deterministic reruns; retain the 210 original survivor rows at the parsed field level.
required_checks: Every selected repair case remains collapsed under the corrected probe.
Every corrected collapsed row has finite collapse_time, collapse_event='organization_ecology', and a non-'survived' cause.
Seed/rate support after merge remains exactly 24x12=288.
No original survivor row is modified.
The frozen Sept. 12 analyzer is applied unchanged to the repaired merged CSV.
